prerequisites: Interest in physical fundamentals of computer science

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply basic physical and electrotechnical knowledge in the context of computer science.
Understand the most important phenomena and laws from electrical engineering and apply them to technical processes with the necessary certainty.
Recognize fundamental physical relationships, especially from the perspective of computer science, and use them for the practical implementation of computer science problems.
Explain the basic function and purpose of resistors, coils, and capacitors.
Explain the basic function and purpose of diodes and transistors.
Explain simple digital circuits like flip-flops.

syllabus_topics: Physical fundamentals (forces, charge, structure of matter)
Fundamentals of circuit and digital technology
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 90-minute written examination.
